products.name: Expedition Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists no booster box for this set, so it is priced at 36 packs. The real box also held one of four e-Card box toppers, which are not simulated.

products.name: Scan-Tastic Spectacular Promo Pack [Ho-oh & Rapidash]
products.note: Nintendo Power's e-Reader product (2002): the Rapidash and Ho-oh Wizards Black Star Promos, each with e-Reader dot codes for the Fire Hoops mini-game. No booster packs. TCGplayer listing (group 1418).

products.name: Theme Deck "Electric Garden"
products.note: A 60-card Expedition theme deck, featuring Raichu (Expedition 61); metal silver Pikachu coin + markers. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Expedition theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: TCGplayer's product page market price (product 234504 on 2026-10-01: $550.00, no live listing); tcgcsv's mirror has no row for it.

products.name: Theme Deck "Echo"
products.note: A 60-card Expedition theme deck, featuring Alakazam (Expedition 33); metal silver Pikachu coin + markers. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Expedition theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: No TCGplayer price for the sealed deck: the sum of its 60 cards at the site's card prices (TCGplayer market, Unlimited). A sealed deck sells for more.
